paite: Babulon kho puakgik Amoz tapa Isai in amuh thu.
heading: Pathian In Babulon Asawi Ding
english: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw.

paite: Miliante kongpite a aluttheihna ding un tang sang mai velvul ah chiamtehna takkhia unla, ngaihtak in amau sam unla, khut in hihdan ding hilh un.
english: Set up a banner on the bare mountain! Lift up your voice to them! Wave your hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.

paite: Kei mahmah in ka misehte thu ka peta, ahi, ka mihattak, ka mi kinuamsakte, ka hehna tangtungsak ding in ka samta hi.
english: I have commanded my consecrated ones; yes, I have called my mighty men for my anger, even my proudly exulting ones.

paite: Tang a mipi husa, mipi atam a tam husa bang mahmah! Namte' lalgam a mi omkhawmte chiak vengvung husa! Sepaihte' TOUPA'N galsual ding a sepaihte kaikhawm ei ve.
english: The noise of a multitude is in the mountains, as of a great people; the noise of an uproar of the kingdoms of the nations gathered together! Yahweh of Armies is mustering the army for the battle.

paite: Amaute, TOUPA leh alungkimlouhna vanzat, gam gamlapi a kipan, kawlmong tawpna mahmah a kipan in gam tengteng hihse ding in ahong pai uhi.
english: They come from a far country, from the uttermost part of heaven, even Yahweh, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.

paite: Mau tuaituai un, TOUPA ni anaita hi. Bangkim hihthei a kipan siatna ahong tung bang in ahong tung ding hi.
english: Wail, for Yahweh’s day is at hand! It will come as destruction from the Almighty.

paite: Huaiziak in khut tengteng ahat kei ding a, mihing lungtang chiteng leng azulmang ding.
english: Therefore all hands will be feeble, and everyone’s heart will melt.

paite: Huchi in alau ding ua; damlouhna leh lungkimlouhnate'n amaute aman ding a; numei nauvei bang mai in achi uh ana ding; lamdang kisatuah in a-om chiat ding uh; amelte uh meikuang mel bang ahi ding.
english: They will be dismayed. Pangs and sorrows will seize them. They will be in pain like a woman in labor. They will look in amazement one at another. Their faces will be faces of flame.

paite: Ngai in, gam hihse ding leh huai lai a mikhialte asung a kipan a hihmangthang ding in TOUPA ni thupitak, thangpaihna leh hehna thupitak toh, ahong tung ding hi.
english: Behold, the day of Yahweh comes, cruel, with wrath and fierce anger; to make the land a desolation, and to destroy its sinners out of it.

paite: Van aksite leh aksi munkipte un avakna uh asuaksak kei ding ua; ni lah asuah lai in mialsak in a-om ding a, kha in leng avakna avaksak kei ding hi.
english: For the stars of the sky and its constellations will not give their light. The sun will be darkened in its going out, and the moon will not cause its light to shine.

paite: Huan khovel agitlouhna ziak in ka gawt ding a, migilou-saloute athulimlouhna ziak un ka gawt sam ding. Mikisathei paukhauh lah ka tawpsak ding a, mikihtakhuai kisaktheihna ka niamsak lai ding hi.
english: I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity. I will cause the arrogance of the proud to cease, and will humble the arrogance of the terrible.

paite: Mi dangka-eng siangthou sang a leng manphazaw in ka bawl ding a, mihing mahmah lah Ophir dangka-eng siangthou sang a leng manphazaw in ka bawl ding.
english: I will make people more rare than fine gold, even a person than the pure gold of Ophir.

paite: Huchi in tung a van ka kisingsak ding a, sepaihte' TOUPA hehna ziak in, ahehna ni thupitak ni in, lei leng a-omna mun kisuan tham in linsak in a-om ding.
english: Therefore I will make the heavens tremble, and the earth will be shaken out of its place in Yahweh of Armies’ wrath, and in the day of his fierce anger.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, sakhi delh ek bang leh belam kuamah hawlkhawm louh bang in michih amau chipihte lam chiat anga ding ua, michih amau gam lam chiat ah ataimang ding uh.
english: It will happen that like a hunted gazelle and like sheep that no one gathers, they will each turn to their own people, and will each flee to their own land.

paite: Muh a om peuhmah dawt pailet in a-om ding a, huan, mat a om peuhmah namsau a satpaih in a-om ding.
english: Everyone who is found will be thrust through. Everyone who is captured will fall by the sword.

paite: Anaungekte uh leng amitmuh un zan dimdem khop a leitual satna a zat in a-om ding uh; a-innte uh loh in a-om dia, azite uh leng mawksual in a-om ding uh.
english: Their infants also will be dashed in pieces before their eyes. Their houses will be ransacked, and their wives raped.

paite: Ngai in, Mediate amau sual ding in ka tokthou ding a, huaite'n dangka alimsak kei ding ua, dangka-eng leng akipahpih sam kei ding uh.
english: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, who will not value silver, and as for gold, they will not delight in it.

paite: Athalpeute un tangvalte azansak ding a; gil a gahte hehpihna himhim anei kei ding uh; amit un naupangte ahawi kei ding uh.
english: Their bows will dash the young men in pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb. Their eyes will not spare children.

paite: Huan Babilon, gam chih thupina, Kaldaite kisaktheihpih thil hoihtak, Pathian in Sodom leh Gomorrah asukman lai bang in a-om ding uh.
english: Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldeans’ pride, will be like when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.

paite: Chik mah chiang in leng huai ah mi a-om nawnta kei ding uh, suan om lai siah in leng asung a om a-om sam kei ding. Arab mite'n huai ah apuaninte uh akai kei ding ua; belamchingte'n huai ah abelamhonte uh akualsak kei ding uh.
english: It will never be inhabited, neither will it be lived in from generation to generation. The Arabian will not pitch a tent there, neither will shepherds make their flocks lie down there.

paite: Gamdai a gamsate huai ah a-om ding ua; a-innte uh simbute inn in adim ding a; vasa ngawngsaute huai ah ateng ding ua, sathakte huai ah amawl leklek ding uhi.
english: But wild animals of the desert will lie there, and their houses will be full of jackals. Ostriches will dwell there, and wild goats will frolic there.

paite: A-insangte uah ngiate aham ding ua, sihalte leng a-inpi nuam mahmahte uah aham ding uh; huan, agawt hun ding atung dekta a, anite leng suksau in a-om kei ding hi.
english: Hyenas will cry in their fortresses, and jackals in the pleasant palaces. Her time is near to come, and her days will not be prolonged.
